brush_hair: a person repeatedly moves a hairbrush through the hair to brush and smooth it
cartwheel: a person rotates the body sideways with hands and feet touching the ground in sequence
catch: a person reaches out with both hands to intercept and grasp a moving object
chew: a person repeatedly moves the jaw up and down to chew food or gum
clap: a person raises both hands and repeatedly claps them together
climb: a person ascends a vertical surface by pulling and pushing with hands and feet
climb_stairs: a person ascends stairs by alternately lifting and placing feet on higher steps
dive: a person jumps from an edge and descends into the water
draw_sword: a person pulls a sword from its sheath in a swift drawing motion
dribble: a person continuously bounces a basketball with one hand while moving
drink: a person lifts a container to the mouth, drinks, and lowers it
eat: a person brings food to the mouth, chews, and swallows
fall_floor: a person loses balance and falls downward onto the floor
fencing: a person lunges forward and thrusts a foil at another person in a fencing exchange
flic_flac: a person jumps backward, arches the body, and flips over both hands to land on the mat
golf: a person swings a golf club back and down to strike the ball
handstand: a person kicks the legs up and balances upside down on both hands
hit: a person swings an arm or weapon forcefully to strike a target
hug: a person moves toward another person and wraps arms around them in an embrace
jump: a person bends the knees, pushes off the ground, becomes airborne, and lands
kick: a person raises one leg and extends the foot to kick a target or into the air
kick_ball: a person approaches a soccer ball and swings one leg to kick it away
kiss: a person moves face close to another person until lips touch or nearly touch
laugh: a person opens the mouth wide and shakes the upper body while laughing
pick: a person bends down, grasps an object, and lifts it off the ground
pour: a person tilts a container to pour liquid out of it
pullup: a person pulls body upward on a bar until the chin rises above it, then lowers back down
punch: a person extends a clenched fist rapidly forward to strike a target
push: a person extends both arms and pushes an object away with force
pushup: a person repeatedly lowers the chest toward the ground and pushes back up in a plank position
ride_bike: a person pedals a bicycle forward while steering with the handlebars
ride_horse: a person rides a horse forward with rhythmic motion while holding the reins
run: a person moves forward quickly with alternating leg strides and arm swings
shake_hands: a person reaches out, grasps another person's hand, and shakes it up and down
shoot_ball: a person raises a basketball and releases it upward toward the hoop
shoot_bow: a person draws the bowstring back, aims, and releases the arrow toward a target
shoot_gun: a person aims a gun and pulls the trigger to fire
sit: a person bends the knees and lowers body down onto a seat or the ground
situp: a person repeatedly lifts the torso toward the knees and lowers back down while lying on the back
smile: a person gradually lifts the corners of the mouth into a smile
smoke: a person inhales from a cigarette and exhales smoke into the air
somersault: a person tucks the body and rolls forward or backward in a full rotational flip
stand: a person rises from a seated position to an upright standing posture
swing_baseball: a person rotates the torso and swings a baseball bat to hit the ball
sword: a person lunges forward and strikes with a sword while another person defends
sword_exercise: a person performs a sequence of controlled slash and thrust movements with a sword
talk: a person speaks with mouth movements and hand gestures in a conversation
throw: a person rotates the body and releases an object forward through the air
turn: a person rotates the head or body to change facing direction
walk: a person moves forward by alternately stepping with coordinated arm swings
wave: a person raises one hand and moves the arm side to side in a waving gesture
